name: waypoint-ai
title: Waypoint AI
description: Quick chat and manage coding-agent sessions through Waypoint.
author: noppanat_wadlom

commands.name: manage-servers
commands.title: Manage Servers
commands.subtitle: Waypoint AI
commands.description: Add Waypoint servers, sign in, and choose the active and default server.

commands.name: search-sessions
commands.title: Search Sessions
commands.subtitle: Waypoint AI
commands.description: Find Waypoint sessions, read live conversations, and rename, pin, reattach, interrupt, terminate, or delete them.

commands.name: quick-chat
commands.title: Quick Chat
commands.subtitle: Waypoint AI
commands.description: Continue your dedicated Waypoint conversation or prepare a new chat on first send.

commands.name: new-chat
commands.title: New Chat
commands.subtitle: Waypoint AI
commands.description: Start a fresh Waypoint conversation without stopping earlier work.

scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint:extension && npm run build
scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('tmp/test-build', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && node --test tmp/test-build/tests/*.test.js
